csv_scope_of_work: The City of Victorville is requesting proposals for Civil Engineering Services in preparation of new preengineered restroom installations at Eagle Ranch Park located at 12587 Eagle Ranch Parkway, Victorville, CA 92392, Schmidt Park located at 13576 Mustang St, Victorville, CA 92394, and Green Tree Golf Course (Holes 5 & 14) located at 14144 Green Tree Blvd, Victorville, CA 92395. The scope of work shall include, but is not limited to, reviewing the site survey and generation of construction documents as stated in this Scope of Service.
